filtered.title: Config model layer now imports from the web UI layer, reversing the existing models-to-web dependency direction
An existing config whose URL was accepted before now crashes startup with an uncaught ValidationError traceback
Config-load SSRF check can be bypassed via a trailing-dot metadata hostname or an integer-form IP (pre-existing gap in the helper)
Loopback URLs now accepted at config load are still rejected by the settings form, so a settings save silently does nothing
Relaxed SSRF validator can be bypassed via decimal/integer IP or trailing-dot metadata hostname (pre-existing helper gap)
Config the old code loaded (e.g. http://0.0.0.0:7878) now crashes startup with an uncaught ValidationError traceback
Load-time and UI-save validators disagree on loopback IPs: config with 127.0.0.1 loads but any settings save is silently refused
